dz: 西北东方航空6231号班机,又一架波音727,在约翰·肯尼迪国际机场西北坠毁.
de: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 6231, another Boeing 727, crashes northwest of John F. Kennedy International Airport.

t: Martinair Flight 138号班机坠入斯里兰卡马斯克利亚的Saptha Kanya…

dz: Martinair Flight 138号班机坠入斯里兰卡马斯克利亚的Saptha Kanya山脉,造成191人死亡.
de: Martinair Flight 138 crashes into the Saptha Kanya mountain range in Maskeliya, Sri Lanka, killing 191.

te: In the Vietnam War, the North Vietnamese forces launch their 1975 Spring Offensive (to 30 April 1975), which results in…
dz: 在越南战争中，北越军队发动了 1975 年春季攻势（至 1975 年 4 月 30 日），导致南越最终投降。
de: In the Vietnam War, the North Vietnamese forces launch their 1975 Spring Offensive (to 30 April 1975), which results in the final capitulation of South Vietnam.

dz: 马耳他成为英联邦内的共和国。

te: Nelson Rockefeller is sworn in as Vice President of the United States under President Gerald Ford under the provisions …
dz: 根据"美国宪法第二十五修正案"的规定,纳尔逊·洛克菲勒宣誓就任杰拉尔德·福特总统领导下的美国副总统.
de: Nelson Rockefeller is sworn in as Vice President of the United States under President Gerald Ford under the provisions of the Twenty-fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution.

dz: 大科摩罗、昂儒昂和莫埃利投票成为科摩罗的独立国家。 马约特仍由法国管理.
de: Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli vote to become the independent nation of Comoros. Mayotte remains under French administration.
